tara (product): quick sync on streaming choices + launch gates — we need a prioritized proposal for next-week PM review. SSE vs WS is resurfacing from customers.
omar (eng-runtime): TL;DR: WS gives bidi and multiplexing, SSE simpler for CDN/internets with proxies. but runtime cost and backpressure semantics differ.
jin (eng-ml): also think about delta format first: token-deltas (raw tokens) vs structured patches (json deltas). customers who need structured output (tables/tool-calls) push for patch-like deltas.
sam (sdk): SDK impact: mobile clients prefer SSE because it's simpler to integrate with native event streams. websockets require connection handling and reconnection logic we don't yet expose in SDKs.
clara (design): UX: we need deterministic finish reasons surfaced to callers so clients can decide whether to show partials vs spinner. "incomplete/timeout/final" are the three that matter.
matt (solutions): +1 from FinCorp and RetailX: they want tool/function call streaming (streaming tool invocation metadata) so they can start rendering results before full completion.
tara (product): good. propose we frame decision as: 1) transport (SSE v WS) priority tiers by persona, 2) delta format for structured vs token, 3) finish_reason semantics and headers.
omar (eng-runtime): engineering constraints: multiplexing + priority queues are nontrivial on SSE (requires multiple event types and client demux). WS lets us reuse existing bidi channel for control messages.
jin (eng-ml): note: structured deltas -> we should send 'delta-type' metadata on each chunk: e.g. `{"delta_type":"text"}` or `{"delta_type":"json-patch"}` so clients can route.
sam (sdk): can we commit to a canonical ordering rule? out-of-order chunks on flaky mobile kills UX. need sequence numbers on each chunk.
clara (design): agree. sequence number + partial/complete flag. finish_reason should be a top-level message when the stream ends.
matt (solutions): compliance ask: some customers need explicit acknowledgement that streaming never leaks partials to logs until marked final. how do we satisfy audit controls?
omar (eng-runtime): we can gate streaming logs by finalization flag. runtime already tags tokens with request id; add final_write only after finish_reason==final.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: streaming-proto-stub v1 -> canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC if tests pass :white_check_mark:
jack (ops): (added) watch: canary only for hosted initially, Dedicated/private later.
tara (product): launch criteria draft: - SDK parity (js, py, mobile) for basic SSE consumption - telemetry: per-token latency, partial-rate, reorders - finish_reason contract (final/incomplete/timeout) documented - customer signoff from 2 pilot accounts (FinCorp, EduLabs) - fallback path: if streaming fails, return final non-stream response within 2s
jin (eng-ml): also add quality gate: streaming deltas must not change final artifact vs non-stream > 0.5% regression on our eval promptset.
sam (sdk): implementation notes for SDKs: expose simple SSE client with auto-reconnect + dedupe via seq number. sketch: ```onmessage(e){ parse(e.data); if(seq<=seen) return; apply(); }```
clara (design): UX flows: 1) partial assistant text 2) tool/result streaming (structured) 3) final indicator with finish_reason. We should provide example UI patterns in library.
matt (solutions): prioritize structured deltas for RetailX use-case (product catalog streaming). otherwise token-only for low-latency chat apps.
omar (eng-runtime): proposed prioritization (engineering): a) SSE token streaming MVP (fastest engineering path) b) structured-deltas over SSE (adds event schema) c) WS multiplexing + tool-calls (longer runway)
tara (product): product counter-proposal: ship b) structured-deltas + seq on SSE as MVP, because two of our largest pilots demand structured streaming. faster adoption >= revenue.
omar (eng-runtime): that's doable but adds parsing/validation and more QA. timeline +1 sprint.
jin (eng-ml): we need tests to assert final equivalence and to exercise function-call streaming semantics. I'll add evals.
sam (sdk): ETA if prioritized: JS/py SSE helpers in 2 weeks, mobile in 4.
clara (design): I'll draft UI kit and example flows by EOW.
tara (product): decision for PM review: go with product counter-proposal. MVP = SSE with structured-delta events, seq numbers, finish_reason contract. WS multiplexing blocked to roadmap Q2.
matt (solutions): pinging FinCorp to confirm pilot scope.
deploy-bot: note: created ticket PROD-STREAM-142 (sse-structured-mvp) assigned to eng-runtime.
tara (product): action items: - omar: implementation plan + perf impact estimate (due Tue) - sam: SDK wireframes + seq API (due Wed) - jin: eval suites for final-equivalence + function-stream (due Wed) - clara: UX kit + examples (due Fri) - matt: customer pilot SOW + success criteria (due Fri)
omar (eng-runtime): ack. will add fallback docs for Dedicated/private (KMS/logging constraints).
tara (product): ok. I'll put this into next-week PM review deck. thanks all :thumbsup:
